An '''electronic translator''' was a device that could automatically [[Translator/Legends|translate]] between various [[language]]s.

Some electronic translators were used to translate writings from different languages and read them aloud in [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]].<ref name="TotJ">[[Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 2|''Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith'' 2]]</ref> Other such devices could translate speech in another language to Basic and vice versa,<ref name="Greedo">{{StoryCite|story=A Hunter's Fate: Greedo's Tale|book=Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina}}</ref> like the [[Translator collar/Legends|Ithorian translators]]<ref name="Friends and Enemies">{{TCW|Friends and Enemies}}</ref> or the [[vocalizer mask]]s worn by [[Anomid/Legends|Anomids]].<ref name="GG12">''[[Galaxy Guide 12: Aliens — Enemies and Allies]]''</ref>

Electronic translator variants used in the Galaxy included the [[personal translator]]s, [[Personal Universal Translator]]s, [[Translatacomp/Legends|translatacomps]], [[VoxBox]]es, [[electronic mask]]s and [[transliterator]]s.

==History==
The [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] used an early translation device called a [[language convertor lexicon]] even before the times of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to contact the [[Vodran (species)/Legends|Vodrans]].<ref name="GG12" />

More advanced electronic translators were already in use in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] around [[3997 BBY]]&mdash;that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]] used one to translate a pair of [[Sith scroll/Legends|Sith scrolls]] and therefore uncover the identity of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]].<ref name="TotJ" />
